title: Mây đêm
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): clouds drifting across a night sky: the dark pad and a far choir moving very slowly, glass glinting softly and rarely high above. D minor 9th colours at 48 bpm, about six minutes. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
